outlook.discussion: 1. Western Central Pacific: Showers and thunderstorms continue to show signs of organization with an area of low pressure just crossing the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston Atoll. Earlier satellite wind data indicated that the circulation was also becoming better defined. If these current trends continue, the system is likely to become a tropical depression, possibly as soon as later today.
